display_name: Phase1 balanced posterior utility source validation

authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 source-only fixed model evaluation; TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six frozen class-conditional posterior waveform hypotheses; candidate F feature/probability, predicted noise and forward residual
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No true source labels used in evaluation; U_s truth, V and test not read
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout IDs, all physical IDs previously observed in other views; frozen clean F pseudo labels only
